context.hint: Check that a background cleanup service applies the current retention policy to each unit of work.
context.surface: A background job deletes expired records in batches under a configurable retention policy.
assumptions: Authorized administrators can change or disable the effective retention policy.
Use synthetic records, a controlled clock and an in-memory storage double.

review.invariant: Each cleanup batch uses the effective retention policy for its deletion decisions.
review.verification: In a local fixture, check that the current policy controls the cutoff and that records within the allowed retention window are preserved. Verify that records expired under an unchanged policy remain eligible for cleanup.

source_observation.summary: Targeted checks with a storage double detected inconsistent policy enforcement in the baseline and passed after the worker used the current policy. Live database concurrency was outside this verification.
